stations.title: Elspeth
stations.say: Can they sign the book here?

stations.title: Visitor
stations.text: Types a name and a comment, presses Sign.

captions: By the exit, Elspeth wants visitors to sign the museum's book on the new screen.
A visitor types a name and a comment, and nothing appears anywhere.
You keep each field in state and handle the form being sent, in four tasks.
The entry shows as it is typed, and Sign puts it at the top of the book.
Same book, now it keeps what you type. It even says when a comment is too long.
